title: The month tomato prices jumped across India
summary: In July 2023, the median tomato market moved +330.7% in a month, 4.9 standard deviations from the usual for that month.
why_selected: Chosen automatically: the 4.9σ seasonal move is among the largest on record for tomato, across 582 reporting markets.

evidence.observations: monthly medians of daily modal prices; markets need ≥5 reports in both months
caveats: Many market points are district centres, not mandi gates.
Modal prices are reported aggregates, not transaction offers.

scenes.headline: July 2023
scenes.caption: Tomato prices across 582 markets that reported in both June 2023 and July 2023.

scenes.headline: Median move +330.7%
scenes.caption: The typical market's tomato price jumped 330.7% in one month. 99% of markets moved the same way.

scenes.headline: 4.9× the usual swing
scenes.caption: Compared with the same month in every earlier year on record, this move was 4.9 standard deviations from normal.

scenes.headline: Punjab
scenes.caption: Neighbouring markets moved together: the 54 reporting markets in Punjab had a median change of +593.0%.

scenes.headline: Narwana
scenes.caption: Narwana (Haryana), one of the busiest markets among the biggest movers: monthly median ₹750 → ₹7,000 per quintal (+833.3%).

scenes.headline: What this does and doesn't show
scenes.caption: These are reported wholesale modal prices, not causes. Weather, arrivals or policy may explain the move, but this story shows only what markets reported.

conclusion: These are reported wholesale modal prices, not causes. Weather, arrivals or policy may explain the move, but this story shows only what markets reported.

sources.title: Agmarknet / data.gov.in daily mandi modal prices (retained AGRINET snapshot)
